status_legend.documented: stated in the vendor's current docs
status_legend.public-source: read from the vendor's open-source code
status_legend.unverified: the mechanism exists but the docs do not say this key works there; emitted with a warning

claude.settings.modelSettings.autoCompac.values: integer 100000..1000000 or "auto"; capped at the model's window
claude.settings.modelSettings.autoCompac.note: Per model; wins over top-level autoCompactWindow in the same file. Keyed by canonical name (e.g. claude-opus-5-5), which also matches its alias, date-suffixed, [1m] and recognized provider-specific IDs.

claude.settings.autoCompactWindow.values: integer 100000..1000000; capped at the model's window
claude.settings.autoCompactWindow.note: Applies to every model in that file unless modelSettings sets one.

claude.agent.autoCompactWindow.note: Lowers the window for that subagent. A subagent's window is sized by its own model.

claude.env.CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WIND.values: token count 100000..1000000 (k/M suffix needs v2.1.304+; a bare 200 means 200 tokens)
claude.env.CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WIND.note: Takes precedence over --autocompact, /autocompact and autoCompactWindow; applies to every model in the session.

claude.flag.--autocompact.values: 100K..1M as 200000, 500k, 1M, or 100..1000 meaning thousands; or auto
claude.flag.--autocompact.note: One launch only; overrides saved settings, not the env var.

claude.env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKEN.note: For gateway or custom model IDs Claude Code does not recognize (it assumes 200K for them).

codex.config.model_auto_compact_token_li.values: number of tokens; unset = model default (90% of the context window); configured values are clamped to that 90%
codex.config.model_auto_compact_token_li.note: Global for the session's model; there is no per-model table.

codex.flag.-c.note: One run; highest precedence above profiles, project and user config.

codex.profile.model_auto_compact_token_l.note: Profile files exist, but the docs do not list which keys they may set.

codex.agent.model_auto_compact_token_lim.where: agents.<name>.config_file = "<role>.toml" (a config layer for that role)
codex.agent.model_auto_compact_token_lim.note: The role config layer exists; the docs do not say compaction keys are honoured in it.

codex.env.note: No documented environment variable sets the auto-compact limit.

dsh.plugin.compaction-basic.modelPolicie.values: thresholdRatio: fraction of the context window (default 0.8, must exceed retainRatio 0.16); headroomTokens: tokens kept free beyond the output reserve (default 65536); trigger = min(window x thresholdRatio, window - reserved output - headroomTokens); modelPolicies[] overrides per exact provider/model
dsh.plugin.compaction-basic.modelPolicie.note: Experimental: the keys come from dsh's published config catalog, but where a user's plugin config lives was not verified; check that the plugin loads after editing.

claude-code.anthropic: Anthropic API: use the canonical model name as the modelSettings key.
claude-code.bedrock: Amazon Bedrock: model IDs differ (e.g. regional inference profile IDs); recognized provider IDs match the canonical modelSettings entry. Check /model shows a recognized model and the expected window.
claude-code.vertex: Google Cloud Agent Platform (Vertex): IDs may carry an @date suffix, which Claude Code strips; same canonical modelSettings entry.
claude-code.foundry: Microsoft Foundry: as above, provided Claude Code recognizes the model ID.
claude-code.gateway: LLM gateway / custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL alias: Claude Code may not recognize the ID and assumes a 200K window. Map it with modelOverrides, append [1m] for 1M models, or set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS; otherwise the threshold is capped at 200K.

codex.openai: OpenAI (default provider): the limit is clamped to 90% of the model's context window.
codex.amazon-bedrock: Built-in Bedrock provider (model_providers.amazon-bedrock): window depends on the model; set model_context_window if Codex does not know it.
codex.ollama / lmstudio: Local OSS providers: windows are often much smaller; the recommendation is clamped to 90% of the window seen in your logs.
codex.custom: Custom model_providers.<id>: set model_context_window so the 90% clamp uses the right window.
